summary: Backend-only testing of the new AI quota / rate-limiting endpoints (/api/ai/quota, /api/ai/reward, /api/ai/chat, /api/ai/summarize, /api/ai/translate). Wrote pytest suite with 6 test classes covering all 7 requested scenarios. All 6 tests PASS against the public preview backend. Guest auth, quota shape for new users, per-call increment via chat, 429 after 5 calls, +5 reward bonus, MAX_BONUS_PER_DAY=15 cap with 400 on 4th grant, and quota enforcement on both /ai/summarize and /ai/translate all verified. No functional bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~966 lines - consider splitting AI, notes, todos, habits, etc. into separate modules for maintainability (not a functional bug).
_check_and_increment_quota re-reads the doc but returns the pre-increment snapshot; callers don't use it, so no impact, but a subtle inconsistency for future readers.

reset_at is computed as tomorrow-midnight UTC each call; if server timezone assumptions differ from client's 'daily', users near midnight may see a quota reset mismatch. Currently acceptable since _today_key uses UTC too - just note for future localization.
seed_data_creation: Each test class creates its own guest user via POST /api/auth/guest (name='TEST_QuotaUser'). No shared state, no cleanup needed since each user is isolated by user_id and quota records keyed by date.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_ai_quota.py. It uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (falls back to localhost:8001). Each test uses a fresh guest session to keep quotas independent. Because /ai/chat calls hit the real Gemini via emergentintegrations, the full suite takes ~60s to run.

detailed_results.TestQuotaInitial::test_initial_quota_new: PASS - new user returns used=0, bonus=0, free_limit=5, total=5, remaining=5, bonus_available=true, max_bonus=15, reset_at present.
detailed_results.TestChatQuotaAndRateLimit::test_chat_inc: PASS - 5 successful /ai/chat calls, each incremented used by 1 (verified via /ai/quota). 6th call returned 429 with detail.error='quota_exceeded', message contains 'free AI limit', limit=5, used=5, reset_at present.
detailed_results.TestRewardGrantsBonus::test_reward_after: PASS - After 5 chats, POST /ai/reward returned granted=5, bonus=5, total=10, remaining=5. Follow-up chat succeeded and used incremented to 6.
detailed_results.TestRewardMaxCap::test_reward_cap_at_15: PASS - 3 reward calls yielded bonus 5, 10, 15 respectively. Quota shows bonus_available=false. 4th /ai/reward returned 400 with detail containing 'bonus limit'.
detailed_results.TestSummarizeQuota::test_summarize_consu: PASS - /ai/summarize returned 200 with 'result', used incremented to 1. After burning remaining 4 slots via chat, next /ai/summarize returned 429 with quota_exceeded.
detailed_results.TestTranslateQuota::test_translate_consu: PASS - /ai/translate returned 200 with 'result', used incremented to 1. After exhausting quota via chat, next /ai/translate returned 429 with quota_exceeded.
